name: SBS Radio TikTok Clips
summary: Create editable vertical clips with four SBS Radio templates: Political Show, News Briefing, News Direct, and Money Lab.

compatibility.selects: Requires Panel SDK runScript/runShell/askAI, Project importFiles and startAnalysis, Draft setFrameSize, setClipTransform and addMotionGraphic, and the panel file service. Checked on Selects 2.0.580 on macOS. Declares @speaker-profiling off, so Selects builds that read it open the analysis credit dialog with speaker profiling off; older builds ignore the line and profile speakers. News Direct and Money Lab speaker framing requires selects.ai and selects-ai-runtime; when unavailable, the app reports a warning and uses the template fixed crop.
